summary: Verified Goals 403-handling fix and window-focus auth re-sync. Backend regression (29 pytest cases) all pass. All 5 review scenarios pass end-to-end.

verifications.founder_regression: Founder clean session: POST /api/goals=200 (created TEST_RegressionGoal), PUT /api/goals/{id}=200 (edited to TEST_RegressionGoal_Edited). No 403, 'Goal created' + 'Goal updated' toasts shown.
verifications.403_actionable_toast: After overwriting cookie with designer login via fetch (status=200, role=designer) WITHOUT reloading the founder page, clicking Save on New Goal returned 403 and the UI showed the actionable toast: 'This browser is currently signed in as the Designer. Log out and sign in as the Founder to manage goals.' (raw error toast was NOT shown).
verifications.focus_resync: After the 403, both the save() catch's checkAuth() AND an explicit window 'focus' event caused AuthContext to re-fetch /api/auth/me. Role badge flipped from 'Founder Login' to 'Designer Login', add-goal-button disappeared (count=0), and 'Only the founder/manager can add or edit goals.' note became visible.
verifications.designer_clean: Designer session on /goals Master List: add-goal-button count=0, designer-only note visible.
verifications.badge_colors: Founder badge text='FOUNDER LOGIN' emerald styling; Designer badge text='DESIGNER LOGIN' bg=rgb(124,58,237) (violet-600). data-testid=current-role-badge present and correct in both roles.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext focus listener is correct and minimal; no debounce needed given /auth/me is cheap. Consider also listening to 'visibilitychange' for better coverage when switching tabs without window-level focus events (minor).
GoalForm 403 branch is good; same pattern should be applied to Tasks mutation handlers (TaskForm) to show the same actionable toast if a designer cookie overwrites while founder UI is shown.
DialogContent has aria-describedby warning across the app (non-blocking a11y warning in console).

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_RegressionGoal (edited to TEST_RegressionGoal_Edited); cleaned up via DELETE /api/goals/{id}=200. Pre-existing non-TEST user goals (sdsd, sadsd, darshit leads) were left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified. 403-handling toast + window-focus role re-sync both work. Suggest extending the same 403-actionable-toast pattern to TaskForm save paths. Note that the user-stated 'App has 0 goals/0 tasks' precondition was not accurate — 3 existing non-TEST goals were present in DB but didn't affect test outcomes.
